title: Excellent you don't need a private guide!
text: This tour comes because we did the tour in the Sagrada Familia and we found the narration of the audio guides. What I liked most about these audio guides is that we don’t need a guide and we didn’t have to do it at a specific time because you can do it at any time and day. To those who buy this audio tour I recommend buying the Sagrada Familia tour. The only thing I highly recommend is to read the instructions they send, so you can download the app and find the audios.
author: C3778IGflorenciap

title: Excellent Cultural Tour!!!
text:
The guided tour through emblematic places, full of history and architecture make this guided tour of Dalí a unique experience. 
The 3D sounds of this tour are the most 🙌🏽. Excellent work by Soundwalkers.

title: Amazing.

title: YOU WON'T REGRET
text:

title: The best travel companion
text: Super recommended the Soundwalkers app. You are in town but with the audios you start to be in a fantasy, it is too good to live the full experience. Don't choose archaic guides, choose Soundwalkers.
